messages:
lucy.ng: Heads up — billing dashboard vs invoice mismatch for 2026-02-25 10:00-14:30. Dashboard ~1.2M tokens, invoice shows ~1.5M. Opening a thread to triage, cc @aj and @oliver.
aj: thx Lucy. can you drop the invoice id + a couple example request ids? we can start from event logs.
lucy.ng: Invoice INV-20260226-908. Sample req IDs: req_62a8, req_62b1, req_62f0. Dashboard query I ran: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM metering_dashboard WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-02-25T10:00Z' AND '2026-02-25T14:30Z';`
aj: I see. support view shows ~1.48M tokens consumed in billing pipeline for that window. wondering if dashboard ETL lost some events. @oliver.s any known pipelines flaky around that date?
oliver.s: there was a consumer restart on kafka-metering at 09:52 UTC due to OOM on one pod. autoscaler killed a replica. Consumer group rebalance happened. I flagged it in infra alerts but assumed replay caught everything. checking consumer lag history now.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-02-25-kt-lag (kafka-metering consumer lag). Severity: P2.
oliver.s: consumer lag spiked ~09:52-10:10, but lag alone shouldn't drop events — it delays them. looking at topic retention settings: retention.ms was accidentally set to 72h -> 1h for that partition in a bad deploy at 09:50 🙃. that could have evicted events older than 1h, we lost earliest events for some partitions.
sara.k: that's the reconciliation culprit. if events evicted before replayer ran, dashboard ETL won't see them, but billing pipeline (our nearline aggregator) may have already ingested before eviction -> explains invoice > dashboard.
aj: can we run a replay from the source (api-proxy logs) for 09:00-11:00 and re-ingest into metering topic? is that safe? risk double-counting?
oliver.s: replayer exists: mn-replayer. It supports de-dup via event-id and will tag replayed events. Command I used for a dry-run earlier:```
./mn-replayer --source s3://proxy-logs/2026/02/25/ --from 2026-02-25T09:00:00Z --to 2026-02-25T11:00:00Z --topic kafka-metering --dry-run --dedupe
```
mn-replayer: dry-run shows ~320k missing token-events across partitions p2/p3. Written a small report to /tmp/replay-dryrun-1751234567.log
aj: nice. run non-dry with dedupe and monitor consumer lag. schedule rate-limit to avoid overload.
oliver.s: kicking off actual replay now. command:```
./mn-replayer --source s3://proxy-logs/2026/02/25/ --from 2026-02-25T09:00:00Z --to 2026-02-25T11:00:00Z --topic kafka-metering --dedupe --rate 5000 --producer-acks=1
```
(small note: rate is messages/sec to keep brokers stable)
mn-replayer: replay started at 2026-02-25T12:20:11Z. current progress: 45% (est finish 12:45Z). no duplicate events found so far.
sara.k: while that's running I'll diff billing counts. If replay adds ~300k tokens to dashboard, we should match invoice.
aj: also ping finance to hold invoices adjustments until we confirm counts. @billing-bot can you flag invoice INV-20260226-908 as under review?
billing-bot: Invoice INV-20260226-908 flagged: billing-team notified. Case: BILL-1751.
mn-replayer: replay finished at 12:48Z. Replayed 318,742 token-events. Dedup prevented 14 duplicates.
oliver.s: ETL picked up replayed events within ~5 minutes; dashboard refreshed. reran dashboard query: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM metering_dashboard WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-02-25T10:00Z' AND '2026-02-25T14:30Z';` => 1,513,980 tokens. matches invoice 1,515,200 within rounding/aggregation margin.
lucy.ng: confirmed, dashboard now aligns. thanks team.
aj: great. root cause: accidental retention config change during infra deploy at 09:50 -> partition retention set to 1h, evicted oldest events before replayer. Contributing: replay automation didn't run fast enough + no alert on retention override.
sara.k: Actions: 1) rollback retention config fix (done), 2) add gating check in deploys to prevent per-topic retention changes (OL), 3) add alert if consumer lag + retention < lag window (OL), 4) replay automation: auto-trigger if lag + missing-count > threshold (MN).
oliver.s: I'll open infra PR to block retention override and add the alert: PR #3782.
mn-replayer: I'll add an auto-trigger hook and a dry-run summary upload to S3: GH PR #224 (mn-replayer).
billing-bot: Billing reconciliation note added to BILL-1751: provisional credits may apply pending finance review.
aj: closing thread after postmortem. we'll publish a short incident summary on pagerduty and update runbook. Assigning postmortem owner @oliver.s.
oliver.s: got it. I'll draft the postmortem and include the replay commands + checks. ETA EOD. :thumbsup:
lucy.ng: thanks all. saved a copy of the replay log and reconciliation numbers to #incidents/archives.
